summary: Write the vector t of the definition as γw; the conditions unfold block by block.

steps.claim: Every vector t is γw for a unique w (γ is invertible), so p ∈ link(γ) iff some w satisfies: γw ⊥ X (e*-part of γw is 0), w = γ⁻¹(γw) ⊥ X (e*-part of w is 0), middle part of γw = p₁ and middle part of w = p₂. Splitting w into its e-part a, middle part and e*-part, and the existential over the disjoint union of index sets, these are exactly the stated conditions.
steps.lean:
(mulVec_surjective_of_invertible γ).exists.trans (by
    simp [funext_iff, @exists_sum (Fin _), @exists_sum 𝔰.MiddleIndex,
      @Sum.forall 𝔰.MiddleIndex, -Sum.forall]
    simp [← funext_iff]; tauto)
